description: Test scenarios for MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) propagation in virtual threads

scenarios.name: Standard MDC Propagation
scenarios.description: Tests that standard MDC context is properly propagated to virtual threads
assertions: All MDC keys should be available in the virtual thread
Values should match the original context
Context should be preserved after task completion

scenarios.name: Non-Inheritable MDC Context
scenarios.description: Tests that MDC context marked as non-inheritable is not propagated
assertions: MDC context should not be propagated to virtual thread
Virtual thread should have empty MDC context
UserIdMdcHelper.set() should still be called to set default userId

scenarios.name: Partial MDC Propagation
scenarios.description: Tests propagation of specific MDC keys
assertions: Only specified keys should be propagated
Non-specified keys should not be available in virtual thread
Values for propagated keys should match original context

scenarios.name: Empty MDC Context
scenarios.description: Tests behavior with empty MDC context
assertions: Virtual thread should have empty MDC context
UserIdMdcHelper.set() should be called to set default userId

scenarios.name: Large MDC Context
scenarios.description: Tests propagation of MDC context with many entries
assertions: All MDC keys should be available in the virtual thread
Values should match the original context
Performance should not be significantly impacted

scenarios.name: MDC Context Modification
scenarios.description: Tests that modifications to MDC in virtual thread don't affect parent thread
assertions: Virtual thread should receive a copy of the MDC context
Modifications in virtual thread should not affect parent thread
Parent thread context should remain unchanged after task completion

scenarios.name: Nested Virtual Threads
scenarios.description: Tests MDC propagation across nested virtual threads
assertions: First level virtual thread should receive parent MDC context
Second level virtual thread should receive first level's modified context
Each thread should maintain its own copy of the context

scenarios.name: MDC Context with Special Characters
scenarios.description: Tests MDC propagation with special characters in keys and values
assertions: Special characters in keys and values should be preserved
Empty values should be propagated correctly

validationMethods.name: Direct MDC Access
validationMethods.description: Validates MDC context by directly accessing MDC in the virtual thread

validationMethods.name: Log Pattern Validation
validationMethods.description: Validates MDC context by examining log output with MDC pattern

validationMethods.name: Context Capture
validationMethods.description: Captures MDC context in virtual thread and returns it to parent for validation
